chapter: Vic Gaspard and the Lyric Theatre
title: Gaspard as strict musician, and lesson prices
summary: Gaspard taught by music, not jazz; he charged Summers a dollar and a quarter for about two hours.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I mean, you wouldn't say then that, I mean, there's no records of Vic, you see. I mean, you wouldn't say that anybody listening to your records would get an idea of how he sounded. I mean, he didn't sound like that.

No, no, he's strictly a musician. He didn't play no, no Dixieland much. Yeah. He didn't play by air. He didn't play by air. Uh-huh. Play it all by everything? He'd buy music, everything by music. Well, what, did he teach you to play by music? He teach me to play by music, but he used to play by music all the time. Yeah.

I'd pick up the air and the jazz, you know. Who was it taught you to play? I mean, or did you just pick it up and play and improvise and jazz? It taught me? Yeah. If, you know, if Vic was teaching you music, how come you didn't stand with music? You just...

Well, uh, he's teaching me about music, but, uh, I see that wasn't, that wasn't a go at that time, was it, Harry? That wasn't a go at that time. The music was okay, but he wanted some of that, uh, rough stuff. Yeah. How much did he charge for lessons? Do you remember that? Well, he used to charge me cheaper. He'd charge me a dollar quarter. That was for an hour, or what? No, a dollar quarter for about two hours. We was kind of friends, like. Yeah. We was friends, like. Uh-huh. How much did he charge everybody? I mean, how much would he charge Jack? Would he want? I wouldn't know how much he charged Jack, but we were friends. Uh-huh.

I guess lessons were pretty cheap in those days. Lessons were cheap anyway, though, you know? Well, I mean, I have it one charge dollar, dollar, dollar. Yeah. Professor Shining, but the other one around to charge the ball. Quiet. Yeah. And he'd give you a lesson to him. Yeah. I'm telling you.
